label: Michael John Gallagher
narrative: Gallagher is included here as a structural node rather than an established actor, and the board should say so plainly. He was a Marine Corps intelligence officer, served on the House Armed Services Committee and the Permanent Select Committee on Intelligence, and chaired the Select Committee on the Strategic Competition between the United States and the Chinese Communist Party in the 118th Congress before resigning his seat on 19 April 2024. That combination - HASC and HPSCI seats simultaneously - is precisely the access profile that Luna's September 2025 statement identified as the gate: he was in the category of member eligible to be read in on the special access programs Oversight was told it could not reach. He does not appear as a speaker in any of the three House UAP hearing transcripts and no UAP-specific action by him was located in searches conducted for this domain. He is retained as a node because the intersection of his committee assignments with the SAP read-in gate is exactly the kind of thing later research should resolve, and because his absence from the disclosure caucus despite that access is itself a datum.
